title: The Hidden Truth of House Dust
hook: You might be living in a home made of you.
script: You might be living in a home made of you. Every minute, you shed tens of thousands of dead skin cells. What if you tracked where all that skin actually ends up? Surprisingly, much of the dust in your home is made up of you. Studies reveal that about 80% of household dust consists of human skin cells. If you gathered all the skin cells you lose in a day, it would weigh about the same as a slice of bread. You replace your entire outer layer of skin every two to four weeks. Next time you see dust in your home, remember it’s not just dust—it’s a part of you.
